title.narrative: Social Protection Modernization and Economic Inclusion Project

description.narrative: The development objective of the Social Protection Modernization and Economic Inclusion Project for Tajikistan is to support the Government of Tajikistan in protecting poor and vulnerable households from shocks, promoting economic inclusion, and improving social protection systems. The project comprises of five components. The first component, emergency assistance to low-income families contributes to the achievement of the first part of the project development objective (PDO), by helping mitigate the impact of the current economic and political crisis on newly targeted social assistance (TSA) eligible poor and vulnerable families in 2023. It consists of following sub-components: (i) supporting low-income families to cope with lower incomes; and (ii) outreach and communication. The second component, support to unemployed including labor migrants contributes to the achievement of the second part of the PDO, by helping enhance support to the unemployed and promote economic inclusion. It consists of following sub-components: (i) strengthening employment services to support the unemployed; (ii) enhancing economic inclusion; and (iii) capacity building and awareness raising activities. The third component, strengthening social protection delivery systems objective is to improve the social protection delivery systems in Tajikistan and contribute to the achievement of the third part of the PDO. It consists of following sub-components: (i) strengthening the national registry for social protection; (ii) case management system for integrated provision of social services; and (iii) capacity building and equipment. The fourth component, project management and monitoring aims to provide daily support for execution of the project coordination and management interventions to ensure implementation progresses smoothly according to the agreed plan. It consists of following sub-components: (i) management and monitoring of components 1 and 3; and (ii) management and monitoring of component 2. The fifth component, contingent emergency response component (CERC) will support the government's emergency response and reconstruction in an eligible emergency.

The objective of the project is to support the Government of Tajikistan in protecting poor and vulnerable households from shocks, promoting economic inclusion, and improving social protection systems.

condition.narrative: ESCP, Section CS1: Not later than two months after the Effective Date, the Recipient shall start provide training to relevant staffof MLME PIU, MHSP PIU, and other involved agencies.
ESCP, section 2.1: Not later than two months after the Effective Date, the Recipient shall prepare, consult upon, adopt, anddisclose the LMP.

FA and GA . Schedule 2. Section I. B.1.:No later than sixty (60) days after the Effective Date, the Recipient shall adopt twooperational manuals as follows: one for the parts of the Project to be implemented by MHSP (the “MHSP POM”) and one for the partsof the Project to be implemented by MLME (the “MLME POM”), both satisfactory to the Association, and thereafter carry out theProject in accordance with such manuals.

FA and GA. Schedule 2. Section I. A.2.: No later than six (6) months after the Effective Date, the Recipient, through MHSP, shallrecruit to the MHSP PIU and maintain throughout Project implementation, additional specialized staff as detailed in the MHSP POM,all with qualifications, experience, and terms of reference satisfactory to the Association.

FA. Schedule 2. Section I. A.3.: No later than two (2) months after the Effective Date, the Recipient, through MLME, shallestablish and thereafter maintain a PIU (“MLME PIU”) with a mandate, functions and resources and with staff in adequate numbers andwith qualifications, experience, and terms of reference satisfactory to the Association.

FA. Schedule 2. Section I. A.4.: No later than thirty (30) days after the Effective Date, the Recipient shall configure, andthereafter maintain through the period of Project implementation, the accounting software at MHSP to cover activities under theProject in a manner satisfactory to the Association.

FA. Schedule 2. Section I. A.5.:No later than ninety (90) days after the Effective Date, the Recipient shall: (a) update themandate and composition of the Coordination Council to reflect the coordination responsibilities set forth in the MLME POM and MHSPPOM; and (b) thereafter maintain the Coordination Council with mandate and composition satisfactory to the Association.

FA. Schedule 2. Section I. A.6.: No later than thirty (30) days after the Effective Date, the Recipient shall install, andthereafter maintain throughout the period of Project implementation, an accounting software at MLME in a manner satisfactory to theAssociation.

FA. Schedule 2. Section I. F.1.: The Recipient shall prepare and furnish to the Association, not later than November 15 each yearduring Project implementation (or such later interval or date as the Association may agree), for the Association's review andno-objection, an Annual Work Plan and Budget for the Project.

FA. Schedule 2. Section I. G.5.; GA. Schedule 2. Section I. D.5.:No later than one (1) month after the Effective Date, theRecipient shall ensure that an accessible grievance mechanism is established, publicized, maintained, and operated, in a manneracceptable to the Association.

title.narrative: Number of district level employment centers with integrated registration and referral system

comment.narrative: The indicator is intended to measure the capacity of employment agencies at district level to provide tailored support to unemployed and labor migrants

title.narrative: Social Protection Analytical and Informational Center is established and functioning

comment.narrative: The indicator will track the establishing and functioning of the Social Protection Analytical and Informational Center under the MHSP. The Center is established, but not yet fully functioning.

title.narrative: Number of families in the TSA supported by temporary compensation

comment.narrative: The indicator will measure the additional support provided to most vulnerable extremely poor households already supported by the TSA program, and who did not receive ADB's cash top-ups in 2022 By end of August 2024, 95,749 families received payments and remaining eligible families will be covered by cash transfers in Sept 2024.

title.narrative: Share of beneficiaries of the EIP engaged in income generating activities (after 6 months)

comment.narrative: The indicator will track the number of start-ups which are operational 6 months after grants were awarded. The EIP has not been launched

title.narrative: Number of institutions providing social assistance equipped with computers and connected to the Internet

comment.narrative: The indicator will track the equipping of institutions under the MHSP providing social assistance to population with computers and connected to the Internet

title.narrative: Number of district level employment centers equipped with computers and connected to the Internet

comment.narrative: This indicator will track the progress made by the MLME in equipping its district level employment offices with computers and connections to the Internet

title.narrative: Number of unemployed supported by training and skills development

comment.narrative: The indicator will measure the impact of skills development and training activities designed to support unemployed, including incoming labor migrants. The indicator will measure only those individuals who successfully completed the training and skills development as a proxy to measure enhanced employability. The EIP has not been lauchned.

title.narrative: Percentage of poor pregnant women (TSA recipients) referred to health facilities through the case management program

comment.narrative: The indicator will track the share of successful referrals of poor pregnant women to health facilities through the case management program

title.narrative: Number of female unemployed supported by income generating activities

comment.narrative: This indicator tracks the transition from the successful completion of training to the implementation of startups by women. The EIP has not been launched

title.narrative: Number of unemployed supported by income generating activities

comment.narrative: This indicator will measure the impact of the combined skills development intervention, financial support, and tailored technical assistance to unemployed individuals, including incoming labor migrants. The EIP has not been launched.

title.narrative: Number of beneficiaries of the EIP selected and enrolled in training

comment.narrative: This indicator will track the initial step to the economic inclusion program. The EIP has not been launched

title.narrative: Number of labor migrants registered in the registry of labor migrants

comment.narrative: This indicator will track the progress made by the MLME in registering labor migrants

title.narrative: Number of districts covered by communication and dissemination activities about the cash transfers to TSA beneficiaries

comment.narrative: Number of districts where the communication and dissemination activities about the cash transfers are conducted. Communication campaign is in process.

title.narrative: Share of female-headed TSA supported families who received cash transfers financed by the Project

comment.narrative: The indicator will measure the additional support provided to extremely poor women-headed households covered by the TSA program. 51,710 families covered by cash transfers are women headed.

title.narrative: Percentage of poor pregnant women (TSA recipients) reported having at least 4 ANC visits during pregnancy

comment.narrative: The indicator will measure the efficiency of case management system in taking antenatal care (4 visits during pregnancy) by poor pregnant women from TSA recipient families in pilot districts. The baseline is set based on the utilization of 4 ANC in the lowest income quintile from DHS 2017

title.narrative: Identification of the skills demand in the labor market

comment.narrative: This indicator tracks the preparation and carrying out of a survey to identify the skills demand of the labor market The survey on skills demand is to be launched in Sept 2024

title.narrative: A registry of labor migrants has been developed and is operational

comment.narrative: The indicator will track the development of the registry of migrants, which is an essential tool to provide adequate support to incoming unemployed labor migrants

title.narrative: A registry of unemployed has been developed and is operational

comment.narrative: The indicator will track the development of the registry of unemployed, which is an essential tool to provide adequate and timely support to jobseekers

title.narrative: Number of female beneficiaries of the EIP selected and enrolled in training

comment.narrative: This indicator will track the initial number of female beneficiaries enrolled to the economic inclusion program. The EIP has not been launched

title.narrative: Share of EIP beneficiaries satisfied with procedures of receiving investment grants

comment.narrative: The indicator will measure the extent to which the process of investment grants distribution satisfied beneficiaries of the Economic Inclusion Program

title.narrative: Share of TSA beneficiaries satisfied with procedures of emergency cash transfers delivery

comment.narrative: The indicator will measure the extent to which the various project interventions met the needs of the beneficiaries. This indicator will track satisfaction of TSA beneficiaries (enrolled to the program in 2023) with delivery process of the emergency cash transfer
